desc: The most powerful Micro handheld light. Ever. The Chicro admin light is lighthearted in name but serious in performance. When you purchase a Chicro, you get the light, battery, and charging cord. Everything you need in a small box. With 350 Lumens of light, it will light up a dark room. And with a low-power setting as well, you can dial that back to 35 Lumens of light for all the up-close tasks where you do not want overpowering light.
